## Goal
Prove which causes in `scope.md` (A, B, C) are real, in claude 2.1.318 inside herdr.

## AC
1. Throwaway herdr panes only (name them `repro-*`; never touch a real squad pane or run cswitch/cautoswitch on one). Close every pane and process you start by PID ([SAFE-3]).
2. Four cases, each: herdr status while idle at the prompt, what `herdr agent wait --until idle --until done` returns (exit code, time), what typing `/exit` does, what the screen shows afterwards.
   - Monitor running
   - background shell running (`1 shell`)
   - subagent running
   - permission prompt open
3. For the background-work dialog: its exact text, the choices, and which key/answer exits cleanly; whether a background shell is killed on `/exit` (no dialog).
4. How cswitch can detect each case before `/exit` (herdr status, `herdr pane read` text, or the process tree). Give one recommended detection rule and the exit code cswitch should return for "skipped: busy".
5. Results in a new `## Background work (repro 2026-11-04)` section of HANDOFF.md, at most 60 lines, with the exact commands used. Evidence in `evidence.md` next to this task.
